description: This Java class `GeronimoTransactionFactory` implements the `TransactionFactory` interface to provide transaction management functionalities using Geronimo transaction manager within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for obtaining transaction managers, user transactions, database connections, and graceful shutdown handling.

classes.name: GeronimoTransactionFactory
classes.description: Implements the TransactionFactory interface to manage transactions using Geronimo within OFBiz.

methods.name: getTransactionManager
methods.description: Returns the geronimo transaction manager instance.

methods.name: getUserTransaction
methods.description: Returns the transaction manager as a UserTransaction.

methods.name: getTxMgrName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of the transaction manager.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Obtains a database connection for the given helper info, using inline JDBC configuration if available.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Closes all connection factories, performing cleanup.
